description: td-1: file a signed, chained public dispute against a claim (needs your API key). It never deletes or changes the claim; reads of the claim gain disputes {active, items} and the /sdk guards refuse to rely on a claim with active disputes. code: false|stale|wrong_subject|unsafe|privacy|duplicate|other; reason: 3-500 chars, neutral wording; evidence: ev-1 links. Withdraw your dispute with withdraw_claim on its csd- id.
name: dispute_claim
title: Dispute a claim in the open (tombstone)
